title: Compatibility of higher pullback tensor comparisons with composition
statement: Let l be prime, E a finite extension of Q_l, Ω an algebraic closure of Q_l, and f:X→Y and h:Z→X morphisms of schemes on which l is invertible. Use the integral, rational and common-stage categories and canonical comparison maps of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom, def-pur-completed-pullback-tensor-comparison], and the normalized pullback compositors of [def-pod-rational-common-pullback-composition]. At each of the three coefficient levels the canonical comparison for h≫f, followed by the tensor of the two compositor components, equals the compositor at the tensor object followed by h-pullback of the f comparison and then the h comparison. Equivalently, the predicates canonicalIntegralPullbackTensor_composition, canonicalRationalPullbackTensor_composition and canonicalCommonStagePullbackTensor_composition hold for every input pair. The predicates and normalized constraints are those of [lem-pur-derived-pullback-tensor-constraints].

lean.statement:
theorem pullbackTensorCompositionCoherence {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (h : Z ⟶ X)
    [hX : ∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [hY : ∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    [hZ : ∀ z : Z, Invertible (l : Z.residueField z)] :
    (∀ M N : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E Y,
      canonicalIntegralPullbackTensor_composition l E f h M N) ∧
    (∀ M N : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l E Y,
      canonicalRationalPullbackTensor_composition l E f h M N) ∧
    (∀ M N : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l Ω Y,
      canonicalCommonStagePullbackTensor_composition l Ω f h M N)
